name: Gargi Vachaknavi
shortBio: Vedic-era Indian natural philosopher and brahmavadini celebrated in the Brihadaranyaka Upanishad for cross-examining the sage Yajnavalkya on the ultimate metaphysical ground of reality (Brahman) and cosmic imperishable order (Akshara).
centralQuestion: What serves as the unconditioned metaphysical warp and woof upholding all manifest elements, cosmic worlds, and consciousness itself?

keyWorks.title: Brihadaranyaka Upanishad Dialogues (3.6 & 3.8)
keyWorks.description: Classic Upanishadic philosophical disputation in which Gargi presses Yajnavalkya through regress arguments toward the imperishable Brahman (Akshara).
